notes: Same text as the 2023 twin (see code-location); in 2002 the operand may also be a level-1 POINTER, PROGRAM-POINTER or OBJECT REFERENCE record under an output CD (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9, §2002:13.16.58.2 SR13). CommunicationSectionBinder.BindEntry no longer links such a record as an implicit redefinition of the CD area (it has no character image; FileModel.IsOutOfLineRecord, as for an FD), so it no longer reaches COBOL0899 (kb/Work PB5604). The golden runs ALLOCATE, SET, CALL, INVOKE and RAISE through such records.
